name: owned-vision-preparation
acceptance: First costly task has safe parallel ownership and repeatable whole-boundary benefit. Local Linux SDL3 acceptance only; no publication or release claim.

design.owner: map owns executor, snapshot, private outputs, leases and measured-cost admission. Owner captures all21 transparency/floor layers and current origin/direction/distance policy.
design.workers: Existing persistent cata_thread_pool, at most4 workers and4 jobs per synchronous request. Pure horizontal kernels use owned immutable values and private output blocks; no world, gameplay RNG, Lua or SDL access.
design.merge: Drain all submitted futures, validate owner/generation/cancellation, then fixed chunk/z/x/y std::max merge. Negative infinity preserves untouched/negative/NaN/tie/signed-zero behavior. Vertical casting stays on owner.
design.failure: Partial thread startup joined by existing pool; allocation/enqueue/worker exceptions drain before serial fallback. Nested/cheap/first/stale/cancelled requests do not apply private output. Pool is destroyed before buffers.
design.legacy_safety: Legacy shared-output float and fragment casting remains serial in canonical order; overlapping horizontal axes/diagonals cannot safely share writes.
design.admission: radius>=32, preceding horizontal-only cost>=2ms, requested workers>=2, owner permits workers. First/cheap update serial; no snapshot/pool allocation below admission.
design.default: VISION_PREPARATION_WORKERS=4 only on Linux SDL3 desktop reporting>=4 logical CPUs. Other platforms/curses/Android/fewer CPUs default0. Active multiplayer always refuses admission. Explicit0 is the rollback; restart required.
design.lua: Only require("ccb") / Lua Platform v1; no second runtime or scheduler.
